# Third-party material

| File | Source | Licence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `clip_prompts.md` | OpenAI CLIP, [`data/prompts.md`](https://github.com/openai/CLIP/blob/main/data/prompts.md), unmodified | MIT, Copyright (c) 2021 OpenAI; see `LICENSE-CLIP` |
| `RAIL_CHANGES.md` | Own description of the changes needed to run RAIL's official code; no RAIL code is included | MIT (this repository) |

`clip_prompts.md` provides CLIP's published per-dataset prompt templates, used only by the optional text
heads in `evaluation/xtail_prompts.py`; the reported results use RAIL's single prompt.
